identity.group_construction: Full original source linkage on nonmissing jid OR mpid OR exact normalized_composition, before complete-case filtering. Reuse existing component IDs; do not rebuild on a selected subset.

identity.same_formula_multistructure_policy: All structure/JID rows in one component must retain one role; structure siblings are not independent formula samples.
identity.residual_limits: Formula/ID components are conservative source identity, not certified independent experiments, batches or DFT-run independence.

eligibility_and_consumption.rule: All3original source targets finite plus normalizedcomposition according to prior fixed metadata gate. No new Y-based eligibility decision.

eligibility_and_consumption.exclusion_scope: Whole original components, not just queried cells or selected row subset.
eligibility_and_consumption.negative_bulk_policy: Preserve native values; no positivity/log filtering or deletion chosen after performance.

candidate_statistical_model_pending_inde.form: finite theta=(rho0,rho1); standardized Y=Z, B_i=rho_i Z+sqrt(1-rho_i^2)*epsilon_i
candidate_statistical_model_pending_inde.joint_update: w_h_new proportional w_h_old * p_h(z_newfields | z_alreadyobserved_sameunit,metadata); retain full hypothesis weights and all actual outcomes.
candidate_statistical_model_pending_inde.singleproxy_scope: A single B_i marginal is theta-invariant only under fixed common marginal assumptions; it alone cannot learn theta.
candidate_statistical_model_pending_inde.jointproxy_scope: (B0,B1) marginal depends on rho0*rho1 and can update theta. Do not multiply marginal proxy likelihoods or apply pureproxy formula to jointpanel.
candidate_statistical_model_pending_inde.all_masks: Use the fullGaussian submatrix conditioning for any observed/new subset, including targetfirst, proxyfirst, jointpanel and existinganchors.
candidate_statistical_model_pending_inde.pure_R_first_moment_kernel_scope: Only a valid conditional subroutine. It is not a bound/optimality claim for this full mixed-action task without additional derivation.
candidate_statistical_model_pending_inde.H_reason: Choose from statistical accuracy/development requirements, never enlarge merely to show acceleration.
must_check_with_approved_warm_only_data: Gaussian/tail/pointmass adequacy including bandgap zero behavior if present
whether x-conditioned marginals or another statistical family are needed; stop/review rather than forcefit
